items.text: I am not presently exhibiting any symptoms, and am able to effectively work from home while isolating this week, as per CDC guidelines and guidance from the House Attending Physician.

I’m honored to be named a Humane Society Legislative Fund 2021 Legislative Leader. I look forward to working with my colleagues to continue advancing common-sense legislation to promote humane animal treatment. #humaneawards https://t.co/fC9GHCkZsj

I am heartened that many more families in my community and across the country will be able to receive critical home visiting services and treatment for mental health concerns and substance use disorders. 
https://t.co/IAUGMBzBcr
I commend the Administration for taking the necessary steps to improve America’s health to end hunger and reverse diet-related disease.
Supporting veterans goes beyond ceremonies and giving speeches. Support means consistently honoring your service by ensuring you receive the treatment and benefits you deserve from your country.

We must not accept that over 33,000 of our veterans who bravely served to keep our country—our home—safe are forced to sleep on the streets, without a home to call their own, on any given night in America.

I had a great time in McHenry County this morning, visiting a dairy farm in Hebron to learn more about their work in nutrition and innovation. Thank you, Midwest Dairy, Katie, and David, for inviting me today. I look forward to coming back soon! https://t.co/qK2hHXyd25

Enjoyed meeting with the pharmacists and techs at @Walgreens in Northbrook to discuss their role in our health system. We spoke about my bill H.R. 1770, which would permanently expand Medicare coverage to include testing, treatment, and vaccination services by pharmacists. https://t.co/RHAzGfhcSy

The government of Israel and the IDF must act to defend against and thwart any and all terrorist attacks, and dismantle the terrorists’ infrastructure.

Nick Grimm met with me to discuss funding for pediatric cancer and treatment as well as other pediatric cancer-focused issues. Nick’s daughter is in remission from pediatric cancer; I wish her well and will continue supporting funding for the NIH and National Cancer Institute. https://t.co/0mjZryp69A

Earlier this week Republicans voted for, but could not pass, a temporary spending bill with nearly 30% across the board cuts: 30% cuts to community safety, 30% cuts to school nutrition, 30% cuts to foreign military assistance (including a $1 billion cut in funding to Israel).

I had a great meeting with the staff of @ThriveRehab in Mundelein, which specializes in short-term rehabilitative care. We discussed what goes into caring for their patients and how Congress can work to support the maintenance of skilled nursing facilities like Thrive. https://t.co/UjyMHTxQ3u

24,000 people who receive coverage under the Affordable Care Act would see their average premium go up by $960 per year — a 34% increase.

I joined experts and patients to discuss protecting Medicaid and heard countless powerful stories from those who depend on it.

Yet, Trump and House Republicans threaten millions—including nearly 20% of Illinoisans—by trying to strip away their healthcare. We will not stand for this.
